description: Defines the srs_channel_matrix class for representing and manipulating wideband channel matrices estimated from Sounding Reference Signals (SRS). Includes constructors, accessors, normalization, and comparison methods, with references to external tensor and vector utilities.

classes.name: srs_channel_matrix
classes.description: Represents a wideband estimated channel matrix based on SRS, supporting construction, normalization, comparison, and coefficient access.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix()
methods.description: Default constructor creating an empty channel matrix.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix(unsigned, unsigned)
methods.description: Constructs a zero-initialized matrix with specified receive and transmit ports.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix(const std::initializer_list<cf_t>&, unsigned, unsigned)
methods.description: Constructs a matrix from a list of coefficients and specified dimensions.

methods.name: srs_channel_matrix(span<const cf_t>, unsigned, unsigned)
methods.description: Constructs a matrix from a span of coefficients and specified dimensions.

methods.name: copy constructor
methods.description: Creates a copy of another srs_channel_matrix.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns another srs_channel_matrix to this one.

methods.name: is_near
methods.description: Checks if two matrices are similar within a tolerance based on Frobenius norm.

methods.name: get_nof_rx_ports
methods.description: Returns the number of receive ports.

methods.name: get_nof_tx_ports
methods.description: Returns the number of transmit ports.

methods.name: operator*=
methods.description: Scales all coefficients by a real or complex factor.

methods.name: frobenius_norm
methods.description: Calculates the Frobenius norm of the matrix.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Subtracts another matrix from this one.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the matrix so that its Frobenius norm is scaled appropriately.
